In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] dueled this '''gundark''' on [[Vanqor/Legends|Vanqor]], after Skywalker lost his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] to [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] and Kenobi's was damaged. It was trapped in the a cave by [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and the members of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]].
